# Feature Review Checklist

## Fun

- [ ] Is it enjoyable?

- [ ] Does it create memorable moments?

## Simplicity

- [ ] Easy to learn?

- [ ] Easy to explain?

## Fairness

- [ ] Can players abuse it?

- [ ] Is RNG acceptable?

## Performance

- [ ] Will it scale?

## UI

- [ ] Clear feedback?

- [ ] Good animations?

## Audio

- [ ] Distinct sounds?

## Social

- [ ] Encourages interaction?

## Future

- [ ] Easy to extend?

- [ ] Fits our design philosophy?
